persistentPanels: kit list column (~260px): 新建 button + kit cards

primaryActions.label: 上传完整的品牌手册，自动填充所有内容 (PNG/JPG/PDF · 最大 50MB) dropzone
从零开始 (Start from scratch) → create on canvas

overlays.contentOwnership: onboarding: '在项目中使用品牌套件 — 点击左上角的项目名称，添加品牌套件'

observations.text: Brand kit is a workspace-level library (own route, own list), separate from projects. One kit '未命名' exists, empty.
Kit sections: Logo / 字体 / 颜色 / 设计指南 / 图像 / 品牌指南. Empty state offers PDF/image brand-book upload to auto-fill, or building it on the canvas.
Section tiles are not clickable in the empty state; the only entry points are the upload dropzone and 从零开始.
Onboarding popover states the attachment point: the kit is attached to a project from the project-name menu at the canvas top-left (brand-menu-button).
Scope: brand kit is account-wide and referenced per project (many projects → one kit), not embedded per canvas.

What a filled kit looks like, whether 图像 acts as a reusable reference set for generation, and whether fonts are usable by the text tool — no assets to observe and populating the kit would mutate account state.
